protected_invariants: SUPERSEDING_SCOPE_PURPOSE: this single contract governs the complete Stage D delivery — dedicated stable HTTP CONNECT provider transport, provider-independent pre-consumption proxy verification, project-controlled target attestation, HMAC-SHA-256 shared-secret challenge-response, authorization-consumption ordering protection, secret redaction, regression tests, and the mission governance needed to ship them — and it explicitly supersedes the narrower scope composition of the two prior implementation missions STAGE_D_OWNER_APPROVED_STABLE_HTTP_CONNECT_PROXY_RECONCILIATION_AND_PREFLIGHT_IMPLEMENTATION and STAGE_D_PROXY_PREFLIGHT_HMAC_TARGET_ATTESTATION_IMPLEMENTATION for pull-request packaging purposes only; it supersedes their scope composition and rewrites no historical fact

SUPERSEDING_SCOPE_BASELINE: BASE_SHA=744c4221664c408ce4ce119f049400de6c0ced65 and IMPLEMENTATION_HEAD_BASELINE=76f7319272dac84e7361b4d3507270f3c288cbdc; authorized_paths is exactly the closed changed-path set of that range and is not a wildcard, so a path discovered later that is not already in that diff is not authorized by this contract

SUPERSEDING_CONTRACT_AUTHORITY=EXECUTION_CONTROLLER and BUILDER_SELF_AUTHORIZED=NO: the widening of this scope was authorized by the Execution Controller, not by the Builder, because the two consecutive Stage D proxy missions are not independently mergeable — the earlier intermediate revision contained a security defect that was corrected only by the later HMAC mission — and must therefore land as one coherent pull request under exactly one active contract

HISTORICAL_REVIEW_FAILURES_NOT_ERASED: the intermediate status-line-only design was rejected by independent review, the client-authored nonce-reflection design was rejected afterwards, and only the final HMAC-attested design passed independent review; no intermediate revision is claimed to have been production-ready, and only the final exact HEAD is proposed for merge

DANGEROUS_PATHS=scripts/devops/gatekeeper.sh (deploy_or_staging): the change to this file is the pre-existing already-reviewed change required by the stable-HTTP-CONNECT mission, is confined to it, is not expanded beyond the reviewed implementation, and requires an explicit '## Dangerous File Authorization' section in the pull request body

PR_CREATION_AUTHORIZED=YES_ON_GREEN_GATES and MERGE_AUTHORIZED=NO: this contract authorizes opening one pull request against main when every gate is green, and never authorizes merging it; merge adjudication is a separate Controller mission

NO_NETWORK_SAFETY_RELAXATION: this contract grants no exemption, allowance or whitelist for the AI Workflow Gate no-network rule in any blind-spot path; tests remain local and fake-only with PROVIDER_DNS_RESOLUTIONS=0 and LIVE_PROVIDER_REQUESTS=0, no provider access is whitelisted, and no network exception of any width is created by this governance change

OWNER_SECURITY_DECISION=TARGET_SIDE_SHARED_SECRET: the Owner has adjudicated that a client-authored nonce echo is NOT sufficient proof of a real CONNECT tunnel, and has selected a target-side shared secret with an HMAC-SHA-256 challenge-response; this delivery implements that decision and nothing else, and does not re-adjudicate it or weaken it

INFORMED_REFLECTOR_WITHOUT_TARGET_CONTACT=FAIL: PREFLIGHT_PASS requires a valid HMAC-SHA-256 over a fresh per-execution challenge, computed by an entity holding the configured preflight shared secret; an endpoint that answers CONNECT with 2xx, reads the full challenge and reflects or synthesizes any response without dialing the configured target must fail, because no value the client can author is ever by itself sufficient to pass

SHARED_SECRET_DEDICATED_AND_NOT_DERIVED: the preflight shared secret is a separate contract named by STAGE_D_PROXY_PREFLIGHT_SHARED_SECRET and is not derived from or shared with THE_ODDS_API_KEY, the proxy credentials, any authorization or ledger hash, any backup credential, any Git commit hash or any machine identifier

PRODUCTION_SECRET_HARDCODED=NO and PRODUCTION_SECRET_PROVISIONED_BY_THIS_DELIVERY=NO: no production shared secret appears in tracked source, in a test fixture, in an evidence artifact or in the pull request metadata; the code contains no usable default, and its absence fails closed before any socket is opened and before authorization consumption

FRESH_RANDOM_CHALLENGE=YES and TIMING_SAFE_MAC_VERIFICATION=YES: each preflight execution generates a cryptographically random challenge from crypto.randomBytes, and the received MAC is compared with crypto.timingSafeEqual after an explicit length check; no secret is ever compared with simple string equality

PROJECT_CONTROLLED_TARGET_ENFORCED=YES: the preflight target must be a project-controlled listener and must not be an external provider or third-party host; the provider hosts this repository actually talks to are enforced as a denylist covering the apex and every subdomain, matched case-insensitively and tolerating a trailing dot, and a denied target fails closed with PROXY_PREFLIGHT_TARGET_EXTERNAL_HOST at resolution time before any socket exists, because a provider target would both void the attestation and produce the third-party contact the Stage D invariants forbid

STRICT_2XX_REQUIRED=YES and NON_2XX_ACCEPTED_AS_PROOF=NO: the CONNECT response must be strictly 200-299, and no non-2xx status (specifically 400, 403, 404, 405, 407, 501, 502, 503 and 504) is accepted as proof of anything

PREFLIGHT_BEFORE_AUTHORIZATION_CONSUMPTION=YES: the proven ordering is proxy endpoint resolution, target resolution, shared-secret resolution, TCP/TLS connect, CONNECT to the configured target, strict 2xx, fresh challenge, target HMAC verification, PASS, and only then authorization consumption, request accounting and transmission; any failure before HMAC verification leaves AUTHORIZATION_CONSUMED=NO, REQUEST_INTENT_CREATED=NO, TRANSMISSION_BOUNDARY_CROSSED=NO, QUOTA_UNITS_CHARGED_OR_ASSUMED=0 and TRANSPORT_SEND_COUNT=0

PREFLIGHT_AUTH_PATH_MATCHES_TRANSPORT=YES: the preflight attaches proxy credentials through the one canonical helper whose output is byte-identical to what the real HttpsProxyAgent transmission path sends, proven by a regression test with fake credentials containing '@', ':' and '%'; the fixes already landed on this branch for that defect are preserved and not regressed

NO_SECRET_SHAPE_DISCLOSURE: the preflight shared secret never appears in a log, an error message, an evidence artifact, a JSON report, an exception, CLI output or a test snapshot; it is held in a non-enumerable symbol slot, and neither the secret, a hash of it, nor its length, prefix or suffix is ever written anywhere

PROVIDER_REACHABILITY_NOT_PROVEN=YES: a passing preflight proves the CONNECT tunnel reached an entity holding the configured shared secret, and nothing more; it does not prove The Odds API reachability, provider acceptance, provider quota, general external egress or future network stability, and no artifact of this delivery claims otherwise

THE_ODDS_API_CONTACTED=NO and LIVE_PROVIDER_REQUESTS=0: this delivery runs no real Gate 3 binder against The Odds API, sends no provider request, performs no provider DNS lookup as part of any test, runs no quota probe, creates no authorization, generates no candidate, activates nothing, and reuses no old authorization

PREVIOUS_AUTHORIZATION_UNTOUCHED: the spent authorization bd2d18956ae8e774fbb227bd56fa7619e2da0d4185372ae7e5108caefdc0c34a remains permanently spent; it is not copied, reactivated, un-marked, ledger-cleaned or used as executable test authority, and the historical Gate 3 evidence tree and runtime artifacts are left byte-identical

CONCRETE_PRODUCTION_ENDPOINTS=NOT_YET_BOUND_BY_THIS_DELIVERY: no production proxy endpoint, no production preflight target and no production preflight secret appear in tracked source, and this delivery provisions none of them; it is expected and correct that live Stage D still fails closed, which is the repository-equivalent of PRODUCTION_PREFLIGHT_NOT_CONFIGURED

ROTATING_SOCKS_POOL_FOR_STAGE_D=PROHIBITED and STAGE_D_PROXY_FALLBACK=NONE: the Stage D live provider path must never select the rotating default pool implicitly, never fall back to ports 10001-10040, to a workstation Clash/Mihomo :7897 endpoint, or to a direct Internet connection; an absent or dead dedicated endpoint must fail closed before authorization consumption rather than degrade to any of them

HARVESTING_POOL_UNCHANGED: config/proxy_pools.json, REG-TITAN-40, the 40-node configuration and the ProxyProvider rotation behavior are byte-identical after this change; poolName='default' is not globally redefined and the harvesting pool is not converted to HTTP

POST_BOUNDARY_ERROR_EVIDENCE_GAP=P1 is out of scope for this delivery and stays OPEN_FOR_NEXT_MISSION; the parent-chain provisioning gap, the authority .staging gap and the 40-node bulk proxy provisioning gap are also out of scope and are not fixed here
forbidden_side_effects: contacting The Odds API, consuming provider quota, resolving a provider hostname, enabling the scheduler, starting Stage D, or creating a canonical transaction
creating, reactivating, copying, un-marking, ledger-cleaning or reusing any Gate 3 authorization, including the permanently spent bd2d18956ae8e774fbb227bd56fa7619e2da0d4185372ae7e5108caefdc0c34a

provisioning, configuring, defaulting or hard-coding a concrete production proxy endpoint, preflight target or preflight shared secret, in tracked source, in a test fixture or in the runtime trust roots
generating a shared secret at runtime, falling back to an embedded test secret, or otherwise making a missing production secret silently usable
writing an actual production proxy credential, preflight shared secret or The Odds API credential into tracked source, a test fixture, an evidence artifact or the pull request metadata
reading local .env, printing, logging, hashing or persisting a secret, embedding a secret-bearing URL in an error message, or disclosing a secret's length, prefix or suffix
comparing HMAC values with simple string equality, or replacing the HMAC primitive with a custom construction
starting a network listener in production merely because the reference attestation target code exists
modifying config/proxy_pools.json, REG-TITAN-40, the 40-node configuration, the ProxyProvider rotation behavior, the harvesting pool protocol, or any bulk-harvesting transport
resurrecting a retired transport path, or routing the Stage D live provider path through the rotating default pool
weakening, exempting, allowlisting or otherwise relaxing the AI Workflow Gate no-network rule for any blind-spot path, or adding a network exception of any width to the governance tooling
rewriting, erasing or contradicting the historical record that the intermediate Stage D preflight revisions failed independent review
redesigning bulk harvesting, reopening Blocker #3, Gate 2 or Gate 3, or advancing the post-boundary evidence gap and the parent-chain, authority-'.staging' or 40-node provisioning gaps
force push, direct push to main, branch protection bypass, self-review, or merging this change set
